related.title: 磷施體矽處理器：條件相位與核自旋暫存
related.titleEn: Phosphorus-donor silicon: conditional phase and nuclear-spin storage
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：接受線數報告前需列明被省略的控制類型；沒有串擾證據不可由線數比直接推論可擴充性。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Accept wiring reports only with omitted controls listed; line-count ratios alone do not establish scalability. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 把條件頻差轉成受控相位，清楚區分Hz與rad/s。
related.differenceEn: Convert conditional frequency differences into controlled phases, distinguishingHz fromrad/s.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。比較16×16陣列的逐點與理想行列線數。 線數比=N²/(2N)。 代入 16**2/(2*16)，得到 8 ratio。N×N陣列逐點一線需N²條，理想行列共用需2N條，節省比N/2；不含屏蔽、讀出、局部修調與冗餘。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。合成條件頻差25kHz，作用時間10μs，忽略切換暫態。 Δφ=2π×25000×10⁻⁵。 代入 2*pi*25000*10e-6，得到 1.5708 rad。穩定條件頻差Δf作用t後，相位Δφ=2πΔft；額外單量子位元相位需另追蹤。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Compare individual and ideal crossbar wiring for a16×16 array. Wiring ratio=N²/(2N). Substituting 16**2/(2*16) gives 8 ratio. AnN×N array needsN² individual lines versus2N ideal crossbar lines, a ratioN/2; shielding, readout, trim and redundancy are excluded. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Synthetic conditional frequency difference25kHz acting for10μs, neglecting transients. Δφ=2π×25000×10^-5. Substituting 2*pi*25000*10e-6 gives 1.5708 rad. A stable conditional frequency differenceΔf acting fort givesΔφ=2πΔft; track additional single-qubit phases separately. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.titleEn: D-Wave chain strength: intact chains versus coefficient resolution

related.difference: 量化自動縮放如何壓縮邏輯能量差，避免以無斷鏈作唯一品質目標。
related.differenceEn: Quantify how scaling compresses logical energy gaps rather than treating zero broken chains as the only quality goal.

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。邏輯能量差0.5，鏈強度C=2，其餘係數≤1；這是簡化對稱範圍模型。 縮放差ΔE′=0.5/C。 代入 0.5/2，得到 0.25 normalized energy units。假設硬體允許最大絕對係數1，鏈強度C為最大係數，則所有係數除C；邏輯能量差也除C。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

Compare individual and ideal crossbar wiring for a16×16 array. Wiring ratio=N²/(2N). Substituting 16**2/(2*16) gives 8 ratio. AnN×N array needsN² individual lines versus2N ideal crossbar lines, a ratioN/2; shielding, readout, trim and redundancy are excluded. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Logical gap0.5, chain strengthC=2 and other coefficients≤1, using a simplified symmetric range. Scaled gapΔE′=0.5/C. Substituting 0.5/2 gives 0.25 normalized energy units. Assume the hardware allows a maximum absolute coefficient of1, with chain strengthC the largest unscaled coefficient; all coefficients and logical energy gaps divide byC. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
